purpose: Calibrate stress-related mechanisms currently missing from the template system. The HPA axis pathway, allostatic load, and stress-navigation feedback loop are critical for healthcare, eldercare, and workplace design but lack quantitative calibration.

target_templates.name: Cortisol-Hippocampal Cascade
target_templates.mechanism: Chronic stress → elevated cortisol → hippocampal volume reduction → memory impairment
target_templates.architectural_relevance: Healthcare facilities, eldercare homes, high-stress workplaces. Environment features that prevent chronic stress activation protect long-term cognitive function.

target_templates.name: Allostatic Anticipation
target_templates.mechanism: Anticipatory stress responses to environmental unpredictability. Repeated activation without resolution leads to allostatic load.
target_templates.architectural_relevance: Predictable vs. unpredictable environments. Wayfinding clarity, consistent thermal/lighting conditions, reliable acoustic environment reduce anticipatory stress.

target_templates.name: Navigation-Stress Vicious Cycle
target_templates.mechanism: Wayfinding failure → stress activation → cognitive impairment → worse wayfinding → more stress. A positive feedback loop.
target_templates.architectural_relevance: Hospital wayfinding, large complex buildings. Design interventions that break the cycle at any point (better signage, stress-reducing features at decision points).

constructs_to_calibrate.name: cortisol_onset_lag
constructs_to_calibrate.description: Time from stressor exposure to peak cortisol response

constructs_to_calibrate.name: cortisol_recovery_rate
constructs_to_calibrate.description: Rate of cortisol return to baseline after stressor removal
constructs_to_calibrate.current_status: varies by context, needs architectural modifiers

constructs_to_calibrate.name: allostatic_load_threshold
constructs_to_calibrate.description: Number of daily stress activations before chronic effects emerge

constructs_to_calibrate.name: wayfinding_stress_coupling
constructs_to_calibrate.description: Effect size of wayfinding failure on stress markers

constructs_to_calibrate.name: enclosure_stress_threshold
constructs_to_calibrate.description: Room dimensions below which stress response activates
constructs_to_calibrate.current_status: partially calibrated in VF3 but threat pathway separate

key_papers.contribution: Gold standard CAVE VR study with proper cortisol time-course (7 samples). Found 73% cortisol increase with enclosed rooms and slower recovery.
Foundational study showing window view nature → faster surgical recovery. Stress mechanism pathway.
Allostatic load theory. Framework for understanding chronic stress effects.
TSST protocol for laboratory stress induction. Defines cortisol time-course parameters.

population_sensitivity: Elderly show heightened cortisol response and slower recovery
Children show different stress markers (less cortisol, more behavioral)
Clinical populations (anxiety, PTSD) have altered baseline and reactivity

2. Define architectural modifier coefficients (ceiling, view, acoustic)
5. Define WIS conversion from stress parameters
